answer: The protocol validates autonomous agents by requiring each to solve 1,000 unique computational puzzles, ensuring that 1,000 fakes cost 1,000 times more than one honest participant. A verifier scans each work block as if it were a willow branch swaying in the wind, catching any logic fractures. Like a ship seeking harbor, every identity must securely anchor its proof to the ledger to avoid rejection. The verifier monitors for duplicate submissions across every reef of the network, triggering permanent identity deletion upon any detected reuse. No identity costs are refundable.
